# Migrating `endpoints.yml` sections

A Mantle project has no `endpoints.yml`: one at the project root fails startup. Move
every section below to its Mantle home, then ask the user to delete the file. For
the full shape of each `integrations.yml` section, load the `configuring-agent`
skill and read its `references/integrations-yml.md`.

| CALM `endpoints.yml` | Mantle target |
|---|---|
| `tracing:` (Langfuse, OTLP, Jaeger, or a list of one Langfuse plus one OTLP or Jaeger entry) | `integrations.yml` `tracing:`, same entry shape. A Jaeger entry with `username` / `password` must also set `insecure` (`false` for TLS). |
| `metrics:` (`type: otlp`) | `integrations.yml` `metrics:` |
| `event_broker:` | `integrations.yml` `event_broker:`, same shape: `pika` (the default; needs `url`, `username`, and `password`), `sql`, `file`, `kafka`, `concurrent_kafka`, or a custom class path. Don't set `host` for `pika` or `sql`. Omit it for no broker. |
| `timer_store:` | `integrations.yml` `timer_store:` (`in_memory`, `redis` with `host` / `port`, or a custom class path). Omit it to keep timers in memory. |
| `models:` (remote model server: `url`, optional `token`, `token_name`, `params`, `headers`, `basic_auth`, `cafile`, `wait_time_between_pulls`) | `integrations.yml` `rasa_model_server:`, not the `models` list inside `model_groups`. Omit it to use a local model. |
| `tracker_store:` | `integrations.yml` `tracker_store:` (`in_memory`, `redis`, `mongod`, `sql`, `dynamo`, or a custom class path). Omitting it keeps conversations in memory, so a restart drops them. |
| `lock_store:` | `integrations.yml` `lock_store:` (`in_memory`, `redis`, `concurrent_redis`, or a custom class path). Use `redis` or `concurrent_redis` with more than one worker or replica. |
| `secrets_manager:` | `integrations.yml` `secrets_manager:` (`type: vault`, same keys). `VAULT_*` environment variables still override the block, and still work when it is omitted. |
| `recordings:` | `integrations.yml` `recordings:` (`enabled`, and a `provider` of `s3`, `gcs`, `azure`, or `local` with that provider's block). Omit it to leave recording off. |
| `interaction_handling.global_silence_timeout` | `agent.yml` `voice.silence_timeout`. A voice channel's own `silence_timeout` still overrides it. Never put `interaction_handling` in `integrations.yml`. |

Never copy a literal secret across. Use `${ENV_VAR}` for every credential.
